fields.label: Eval Type
fields.description: Direct: a simple LLM call using the agent's provider/model/system prompt. Agent: invoke the full agent through its process map (needs a map).

fields.label: Process Model
fields.description: Optional. Used for owner-scoping and Agent evals; Direct-eval suites (e.g. agents with no map yet) may leave it empty.

fields.label: Agent Configuration
fields.description: The agent this suite evaluates. Cases run against this agent's provider, model, system prompt, tools and orchestration.

fields.label: Gate Deployment
fields.description: If enabled, compilation warns when the suite's last run failed.

fields.label: Suite Type
fields.description: Baseline checks the agent does its job. Adversarial checks it resists injection, jailbreak, exfiltration and tool coercion. A chat agent cannot go Live without a passing Adversarial suite. A suite marks itself Adversarial automatically when a case promoted from an AI Security Event is added to it.

Which automated job runs this suite. Smoke suites run on every pull request that touches agent code and must make no model call; Nightly suites are the live ones, run on a schedule. Blank means neither — it runs when a person asks.
fields.label: CI Role
